name: Ebix Limited
summary: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited engages in the provision of digital marketing services in India. The company is involved in marketing and support services, such as strategic planning, search engine optimization, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and data-driven analytics; business of trading in securities and shares; hospitality business; and quick service restaurant leasing. It also offers software and e-commerce solutions for the insurance, financial, healthcare, and e-learning industries. The company was formerly known as Justride Enterprises Limited and changed its name to Eraaya Lifespaces Limited in March 2024. Eraaya Lifespaces Limited was incorporated in 1967 and is based in New Delhi, India.
